instruction_en: Turn right to enter the hallway. Walk straight down the hallway, passing a bathroom on your left and a bedroom also on your left. Continue past the kitchen and dining table on your right, then enter the living room straight ahead. Stop in front of the coffee table, with the sectional sofa on your left and the television on your right.
